upstream.description: Secure, locally-run Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for document-based question-answering, utilizing Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemini models with a user-friendly Streamlit interface.

classification.analysis: Airgapped Offline RAG is a Streamlit application for document question-answering that runs entirely locally, using quantized GGUF models (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma) via llama.cpp, LangChain for orchestration, and ChromaDB/Qdrant for vector storage. It targets privacy-conscious users or air-gapped environments who want to upload PDFs and ask questions without any cloud dependency. The stack is Docker-deployable and supports streaming responses, though several features (multi-modal docs, REST API, observability) remain on the roadmap.

use_cases.title: Ask questions over local PDFs without internet access
